mapper.select: SELECT * FROM student_schedule WHERE student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY day_of_week, time_slot
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM student_schedule WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND day_of_week = #{dayOfWeek} AND time_slot = #{timeSlot}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student_schedule (student_id, day_of_week, time_slot, is_available, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{dayOfWeek}, #{timeSlot}, #{isAvailable}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT mr.id, mr.job_id, j.title as jobTitle, mr.day_of_week, mr.time_slot, mr.needed_count, mr.filled_count FROM merchant_requirement mr LEFT JOIN job j ON mr.job_id = j.id WHERE mr.merchant_id = #{merchantId} ORDER BY mr.day_of_week, mr.time_slot
mapper.update: INSERT INTO student_schedule (student_id, day_of_week, time_slot, is_available) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{dayOfWeek}, #{timeSlot}, #{isAvailable}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE is_available = VALUES(is_available)
mapper.select: SELECT mr.job_id AS jobId, j.title AS jobTitle, mr.day_of_week AS dayOfWeek, mr.time_slot AS timeSlot, mr.needed_count AS neededCount, mr.filled_count AS filledCount, (mr.needed_count - mr.filled_count) AS gapCount FROM merchant_requirement mr JOIN job j ON j.id = mr.job_id WHERE mr.merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND mr.filled_count < mr.needed_count AND j.status = '进行中' AND ( mr.day_of_week > CASE DAYOFWEEK(CURDATE()) WHEN 1 THEN 7 ELSE DAYOFWEEK(CURDATE()) - 1 END OR ( mr.day_of_week = CASE DAYOFWEEK(CURDATE()) WHEN 1 THEN 7 ELSE DAYOFWEEK(CURDATE()) - 1 END AND ( (mr.time_slot = 'morning' AND CURTIME() < '09:00:00') OR (mr.time_slot = 'afternoon' AND CURTIME() < '14:00:00') OR (mr.time_slot = 'evening' AND CURTIME() < '18:00:00') ) ) ) ORDER BY mr.day_of_week, mr.time_slot
SELECT ss.day_of_week AS dayOfWeek, ss.time_slot AS timeSlot FROM student_schedule ss WHERE ss.student_id = #{studentId} AND ss.is_available = 1 ORDER BY ss.day_of_week, ss.time_slot

SELECT DISTINCT ss.student_id FROM student_schedule ss JOIN user u ON u.id = ss.student_id WHERE ss.day_of_week = #{dayOfWeek} AND ss.time_slot = #{timeSlot} AND ss.is_available = 1 AND u.identity = '学生' AND u.credit >= 50 AND (u.is_penalty IS NULL OR u.is_penalty = 0)

SELECT u.id, u.name, u.phone, u.credit, u.timepreference FROM user u JOIN student_schedule ss ON ss.student_id = u.id WHERE u.identity = '学生' AND ss.day_of_week = #{dayOfWeek} AND ss.time_slot = #{timeSlot} AND ss.is_available = 1 AND u.credit >= 50 AND (u.is_penalty IS NULL OR u.is_penalty = 0)

SELECT DISTINCT u.id, u.name, u.phone, u.credit, u.timepreference FROM user u JOIN student_schedule ss ON ss.student_id = u.id WHERE u.identity = '学生' AND ss.day_of_week = #{dayOfWeek} AND ss.is_available = 1 AND u.credit >= 50 AND (u.is_penalty IS NULL OR u.is_penalty = 0)

SELECT id FROM user WHERE identity = '学生' AND credit >= 50 AND (is_penalty IS NULL OR is_penalty = 0) AND timepreference IS NOT NULL AND JSON_CONTAINS(timepreference, JSON_OBJECT('day', #{dayOfWeek}, 'period', #{period}))
SELECT timepreference FROM user WHERE id = #{studentId} AND timepreference IS NOT NULL

SELECT id, name, phone, credit, timepreference FROM user WHERE identity = '学生' AND credit >= 50 AND (is_penalty IS NULL OR is_penalty = 0) AND timepreference IS NOT NULL AND JSON_CONTAINS(timepreference, JSON_OBJECT('day', #{dayOfWeek}, 'period', #{period}))

SELECT id, name, phone, credit, timepreference FROM user WHERE identity = '学生' AND credit >= 50 AND (is_penalty IS NULL OR is_penalty = 0) AND timepreference IS NOT NULL AND timepreference LIKE CONCAT('%day', '":', #{dayOfWeek}, '%')
